An '''EMP disruptor''' was a slim stylus that could damage or disable electronic systems. [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Mereel Skirata]] used one to disable a security [[Holocamera/Legends|holocam]] while his brother [[Ordo Skirata|Ordo]] [[Death/Legends|assassinated]] [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Hela Madiry]].<ref name="tz">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref>
